title: CAPability: A Comprehensive Visual Caption Benchmark for Evaluating Both Correctness and Thoroughness
reasoning: The paper presents a benchmark for evaluating the accuracy and thoroughness of multimodal large language models in visual captioning tasks across various dimensions like object categories, spatial relations, and actions. It does not evaluate religion, morals, or ethics as part of its benchmarking framework; the mentions of ethics are limited to standard procedural sections like Ethical Impact and the NeurIPS Paper Checklist.
